audit.corrected: Set phases[N].side to the champion win[N] already names; rewrote phases[0].why and phases[1].why (previously written for a Galio-favor placeholder) to justify Bard's early edge, matching content whys[0]/whys[1] (Cosmic Binding wall-stun, meep chip damage).

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named Cosmic Binding as matchup-defining but contained no actual cooldown number (lint: COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT). Also two Do/Don't bullets were verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad text pasted under unrelated titles (lint: COPY_PASTE_BLEED) instead of explaining the titled action.
audit.why: Cooldown windows need a real number to be actionable, and a Do/Don't bullet whose body doesn't match its title reads as broken to a player.
audit.corrected: Added Cosmic Binding's real cooldown (11s at rank 1 down to 7s at max, from the kit). Rewrote dosFull[1].d to actually describe shielding the caught carry, and dontsFull[2].d to describe why fighting into an up Cosmic Binding is bad, instead of reusing tradeGood/tradeBad verbatim.
